passageLines.text: Romeo is a handsome young man.

passageLines.text: "We are members of the Montague family.

passageLines.text: Benvolio is having a good time.

passageLines.text: She is wearing a lovely dress.

passageLines.ko: "하지만 난 몬태규 가문 사람과 결혼할 수 없어.

passageLines.text: Meet me at the church tomorrow.

passageLines.text: He rushes to Mantua right away.
